spans.s:
pitṛ́ [373], m.
 —1. father;
 —2. pl. father
and his brothers (cf. French parent, ‘relative’),
 61^17;
 —3. pl. the fathers, spirits
of the forefathers, the Manes, 67^16, 83^13,
etc. [origin unknown, see 1182d: cf.
πατήρ, Lat. pater, Eng. father.]

pitṛtas, adv. on the father's side. [pitṛ,
1098b.]

pitṛ-yajñá, m. sacrifice to the Manes.
[yajñá.]

pitṛvya, m. father's brother, patruus.
[pitṛ, 1228c: cf. πάτρως, Lat. patruus, AS.
fædera, ‘father's brother.’]

pítrya, a. of one's father; of (our)
fathers, 78^18; of or belonging to or sacred
to the Manes. [pitṛ́, 1212b: cf. πάτριος,
Lat. patrius, ‘of one's father.’]
